text_en: In the time of King Herod, after Jesus was born in Bethlehem of Judea, wise men from the East came to Jerusalem,
text_cn: 当黑落德为王时，耶稣诞生在犹大的白冷；看，有贤士从东方来到耶路撒冷，

text_en: asking, “Where is the child who has been born king of the Jews? For we observed his star at its rising, and have come to pay him homage. ”
text_cn: 说：“才诞生的犹太人君王在哪里？我们在东方见到了他的星，特来朝拜他。”

text_en: When King Herod heard this, he was frightened, and all Jerusalem with him;
text_cn: 黑落德王一听说，就惊慌起来，全耶路撒冷也同他一起惊慌。

text_en: and calling together all the chief priests and scribes of the people, he inquired of them where the Messiah was to be born.
text_cn: 他便召集了众司祭长和民间的经师，仔细考问他们：默西亚应当生在哪里。

text_en: They told him, “In Bethlehem of Judea; for so it has been written by the prophet:
text_cn: 他们对他说：“在犹大的白冷，因为先知曾这样记载：

text_en: ‘And you, Bethlehem, in the land of Judah, are by no means least among the rulers of Judah; for from you shall come a ruler who is to shepherd my people Israel. ’”
text_cn: ‘你犹大地白冷啊！你在犹大的郡邑中，决不是最小的，因为将由你出来一位领袖，他将牧养我的百姓以色列。’”

text_en: Then Herod secretly called for the wise men and learned from them the exact time when the star had appeared.
text_cn: 于是黑落德暗暗把贤士叫来，仔细询问他们那星出现的时间；

text_en: Then he sent them to Bethlehem, saying, “Go and search diligently for the child; and when you have found him, bring me word so that I may also go and pay him homage. ”
text_cn: 然后打发他们往白冷去，说：“你们去仔细寻访婴孩，几时找到了，给我报信，好让我也去朝拜他。”

text_en: When they had heard the king, they set out; and there, ahead of them, went the star that they had seen at its rising, until it stopped over the place where the child was.
text_cn: 他们听了王的话，就走了。看，他们在东方所见的那星，走在他们前面，直至来到婴孩所在的地方，就停在上面。

text_en: When they saw that the star had stopped, they were overwhelmed with joy.
text_cn: 他们一见到那星，极其高兴欢喜。

text_en: On entering the house, they saw the child with Mary his mother; and they knelt down and paid him homage. Then, opening their treasure chests, they offered him gifts of gold, frankincense, and myrrh.
text_cn: 他们走进屋内，看见婴儿和他的母亲玛利亚，遂俯伏朝拜了他，打开自己的宝匣，给他奉献了礼物，即黄金、乳香和没药。

text_en: And having been warned in a dream not to return to Herod, they left for their own country by another road.
text_cn: 他们在梦中得到指示，不要回到黑落德那里，就由另一条路返回自己的地方去了。

text_en: Now after they had left, an angel of the Lord appeared to Joseph in a dream and said, “Get up, take the child and his mother, and flee to Egypt, and remain there until I tell you; for Herod is about to search for the child, to destroy him. ”
text_cn: 他们离去后，看，上主的天使托梦显于若瑟说：“起来，带着婴孩和他的母亲逃往埃及去，住在那里，直到我再通知你，因为黑落德即将寻找这婴孩，要把他杀掉。”

text_en: Then Joseph got up, took the child and his mother by night, and went to Egypt,
text_cn: 若瑟便起来，星夜带了婴孩和他的母亲，退避到埃及去了。

text_en: and remained there until the death of Herod. This was to fulfill what had been spoken by the Lord through the prophet, “Out of Egypt I have called my son. ”
text_cn: 留在那里，直到黑落德死去。就应验了上主藉先知所说的话：“我从埃及召回了我的儿子。”

text_en: When Herod saw that he had been tricked by the wise men, he was infuriated, and he sent and killed all the children in and around Bethlehem who were two years old or under, according to the time that he had learned from the wise men.
text_cn: 那时，黑落德见自己受了贤士们的愚弄，就大发忿怒，依照他由贤士们所探得的时期，差人将白冷及其周围境内所有两岁及两岁以下的婴儿杀死，

text_en: Then was fulfilled what had been spoken through the prophet Jeremiah:
text_cn: 于是应验了耶肋米亚先知所说的话：

text_en: “A voice was heard in Ramah, wailing and loud lamentation, Rachel weeping for her children; she refused to be consoled, because they are no more. ”
text_cn: “在辣玛听到了声音，痛哭哀号不止；辣黑耳痛哭她的子女，不愿受人的安慰，因为他们不在了。”

text_en: When Herod died, an angel of the Lord suddenly appeared in a dream to Joseph in Egypt and said,
text_cn: 黑落德死后，看，上主的天使在埃及托梦显于若瑟，

text_en: “Get up, take the child and his mother, and go to the land of Israel, for those who were seeking the child’s life are dead. ”
text_cn: 说：“起来，带着孩子和他的母亲，往以色列地去，因为那些谋杀孩子性命的人死了。”

text_en: Then Joseph got up, took the child and his mother, and went to the land of Israel.
text_cn: 他便起来，带了孩子和他的母亲，进了以色列地域；

text_en: But when he heard that Archelaus was ruling over Judea in place of his father Herod, he was afraid to go there. And after being warned in a dream, he went away to the district of Galilee.
text_cn: 但是一听说阿尔赫劳继他父亲黑落德作了犹太王，就害怕到那里去；梦中得了指示后，便退避到加里肋亚境内，

text_en: There he made his home in a town called Nazareth, so that what had been spoken through the prophets might be fulfilled, “He will be called a Nazorean. ”
text_cn: 去住在一座名叫纳匝肋的城中，如此应验了先知们所说的话：“他将称为纳匝肋人。”
